# Best Case Studio

> Best Case Studio produces done-for-you B2B case studies. When a prospect asks "why them?",
> we give your sales team an answer. We find the customer, run the interview and write the story.
> You approve it. Nobody on your team has to chase anyone.
> A two-person studio run by Jon McGreevy and Jessie McGreevy.

## The offer

Two products and one monthly plan.

- Written case study: $2,500. One done-for-you written story, from the ask to your approval.
- Video case study: $5,000. The written case study, a 2 to 3 minute customer video, a 30 to 60 second cut for your homepage and emails, videos for social media, a LinkedIn carousel, a pull-quote and short summary your sales team can paste into an email, and a "when to use what" guide.
- Monthly plan: 2 stories a month, either type, 15% off ($4,250 for 2 written or $8,500 for 2 video). Unused stories roll over for a quarter.

Every video case study includes a one-page guide to which piece to send at which stage of a deal.

## Why it is different

- Real customer voice. A case study is not there to win the deal. It is there to prove the buyer is right to choose you.
- White-glove service. Jessie owns the ask, the scheduling and the approvals. Your client never chases their customer.
- Founder-led. Jon runs every interview personally.

## Who we are

- Jon McGreevy: Founder. Leads content and runs every interview personally. Eight years working with B2B SaaS companies on positioning, content, and conversion.
  https://jonmcgreevy.com · https://jonmcgreevy.substack.com
- Jessie McGreevy: Client lead. Owns the ask, scheduling and approvals.

Jon runs every interview personally. That part is never delegated. Writing and editing may involve trusted help as the studio grows.

## Who it is for

B2B companies, mostly software, where a deal involves more than one person deciding. Any geography; most clients are in North America, pricing in USD.

Not for: pre-product-market-fit companies, anyone wanting anonymous or persona-style case studies, or buyers expecting AI-generated content.

## Examples

- [Extrovert × COMMIT](https://bestcasestud.io/examples/extrovert-commit-linkedin-growth/) — Mila added 4,000+ LinkedIn connections in 2.5 years.
- [SaasyDB × LeadForce Solutions](https://bestcasestud.io/examples/saasydb-leadforce-solutions/) — SaaS leads found in no other database, 3% cold-email reply rate.

## Compare

- [Best Case Studio vs Testimonial Hero](https://bestcasestud.io/compare/best-case-studio-vs-testimonial-hero/): Testimonial Hero is best for video as the main format and larger production. Best Case Studio is best for written plus video from one interview, with the customer ask handled for you.
- [Best Case Studio vs Uplift Content](https://bestcasestud.io/compare/best-case-studio-vs-uplift-content/): Uplift Content is best for written case studies from a specialist writing team. Best Case Studio is best for written plus video and a team that handles the customer ask.
- [Best Case Studio vs StoryVoice](https://bestcasestud.io/compare/best-case-studio-vs-storyvoice/): StoryVoice is best for speed and low cost when a lighter AI draft is enough. Best Case Studio is best for a real customer on record whom a buyer can verify.
- [Best Case Studio vs Content Agencies](https://bestcasestud.io/compare/best-case-studio-vs-content-agencies/): Content agencies are best for full content retainers. Best Case Studio is best for case studies done well and nothing else.
- [Best Case Studio vs Freelancers & ChatGPT](https://bestcasestud.io/compare/best-case-studio-vs-freelancers-and-chatgpt/): Freelancers are best if you have a customer lined up, an in-house editor and time to manage. Best Case Studio is best when you want the whole job done.

## Facts

- Products: Written case study ($2,500), Video case study ($5,000), Monthly plan ($4,250 for 2 written or $8,500 for 2 video).
- One recorded interview, scheduled and run by Jon.
- Jessie owns the ask, scheduling and approvals.
- Two-person studio: Jon McGreevy and Jessie McGreevy. Sheffield, UK.
- Referrals: $500 cash per referral, no cap, paid on the client's first payment.
